SILHOUETTE (most important): genderless industrial command figure. Straight vertical column body. Flat rectangular chest plate. No chest contour. No waist taper. No hip flare. No thigh emphasis. The body silhouette reads as a vertical column, not an hourglass. Slab ceramic armor plates over black graphene underlayer. The figure is not a heroine, not a soldier pin-up, not a human wearing armor — it reads as a cold command system given physical form.

HELMET: fully sealed smooth white industrial helmet. No face geometry. No eye points. No amber glow. No facial muscles. No mouth, no nose, no eyebrows, no chin transition. Only one ultra-thin horizontal cyan visor slit #00C8FF edge-to-edge across where eyes would be. The helmet reads as a sealed industrial precision tool, not a sci-fi robot face, not a porcelain doll.

POSE: both hands clasped strictly behind the back. No weapon in hands. No hands at sides. No hands forward. Motionless symmetrical command stance. Upright vertical axis. No action pose. No contrapposto. No casual asymmetry.

LEFT FOREARM: one small flat white ceramic circular disc emitter, approximately 15 cm diameter, folded dormant flat against the forearm like a wristwatch sized larger. Recessed Empire / White Monolith sigil etched in thin cold-cyan lines on the disc face. No plasma. No barrier field. No glowing dome. No kite-shape shield. The shield element is DORMANT in Phase 1.

RIGHT HIP: one slim black cylindrical monowire hilt, holstered against the hip. No blade visible. No pistol. No gun. No firearm silhouette. No weapon held in either hand.

MATERIAL: brushed B4C ceramic surface. Matte low-specular white ceramic plates #F2F2F0. Subtle micro-grain. Shallow subsurface scattering. Not glossy plastic. Not vinyl. Not action figure finish. Not chrome. Cold-cyan piping #00C8FF along armor seams running dormant.

ARMOR CONSTRUCTION: clean medical-industrial slab armor. Minimal recessed seams only. No Gundam panels. No decorative greebles. No knee lights. No orange accents. No amber accents. No mecha hip joints. No transformer plates.

ENVIRONMENT: vast Imperial Spire interior. Ghost-white #FAFAFA monolith plates. Matte black void gaps. Polished black graphene reflective floor. Cold overhead interrogation key light. Hard rim light from behind isolating the silhouette. No warm fill anywhere. Silent severe atmosphere. Empire / White Monolith sacred-tech architecture, sterile geometry, intentional Ma emptiness, symmetric around figure, monumental architectural scale, figure dwarfed but central.

COLOR: cyan accent only. No purple. No red. No crimson. No gold. No amber. No orange. No warm light anywhere.

COMPOSITION: anamorphic 2.35:1. Centered frontal three-quarter. Vertical axis through figure. Static. Premium quiet luxury rendering, hyper-real industrial material detail, low specular except on brushed ceramic micro-grain.

MOOD: silent before judgment, industrial precision, invariance.
